faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I make a contribution?
faq.a1: Tap the Contribute button on the Home or Savings screen. Enter the amount and choose a payment method (Mobile Money or Bank), then confirm. The contribution is recorded immediately.
faq.a2: Your SACCO sets a monthly contribution amount and due date. You can see both on the Home screen. Making contributions on time keeps your streak alive.
faq.q3: How do I apply for a loan?
faq.a3: Go to the Loans tab and tap Apply for a Loan. Choose the amount and purpose, then submit. Your SACCO admin will review and approve or reject the request.
faq.q4: How do I repay my loan?
faq.a4: On the Loans tab, open an active loan and tap Repay. Enter the amount and choose a payment method. The balance updates as soon as the payment is confirmed.
faq.q5: I forgot my PIN. How do I reset it?
faq.a5: You can change your PIN from Profile → Security & PIN while logged in. If you are locked out entirely, contact support@saccoconnect.app for help.
faq.q6: Why is my transaction showing as pending?
faq.a6: Payments made via Mobile Money may take a few minutes to be confirmed by your SACCO admin. Pending transactions update automatically once confirmed.
faq.a7: Yes. Your account and financial data are encrypted and only accessible to authorised SACCO administrators. See the Privacy Policy in Profile for details.
